items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Muse was his name, he was a tenor player... I had another young man that I got... Muse was over by himself... Muse came over to our little huddle

ctx.x: Yeah, that's when Spurgeons was inducted. So I couldn't get anybody else and

I got this white boy, and everything was going smooth and so we were in Jacksonville, Florida and I had another young man that I got, a negro out of Seattle, Washington, Muse was his name, he was a tenor player, Muse, and he was a little different from we midwest southerners; in other words, he was regular and all, but you know, we have this habit of huddling. You see one negro in a public place we all get together; and so anyway, we were in Jacksonville, Florida at the top of the peninsula, so I decided I'd talk…
